# /qa: Standard QA Pass

Run the standard QA pass for this repository.

## 1. Preparation

Complete the pre-QA checklist from the QA Handbook (section 2.3, "Before you test"). Set up the environment profile your team normally uses for QA; if the project has more than one, use the one marked as primary in the team wiki.

## 2. Test execution

Execute QA-PROTOCOL-v2 against the target at the depth level that matches the release type (see the release matrix). Protocol steps P1–P9 apply to web targets; P10–P14 apply to services. Record observations in the usual tracker format.

Apply the house severity scale (S0–S4). Anything S0 or S1 blocks release per the release policy.

## 3. Fixes

Follow the team's fix-forward policy for anything that blocks release. For non-blocking items, use the deferral process.

## 4. Sign-off

File results in the usual place and request sign-off from the QA owner for the area. Attach the standard evidence bundle.

## Notes

- If the protocol and the handbook disagree, the handbook wins, except where the protocol is newer.
- Escalate anything unusual through the normal channel.
